A familiar feel

At home on your network

Make yourself at home

A short introduction.
A lasting connection.

Start with your TV awake and your phone connected to the same home network.

  1. 01

    Find your TV

    Tap the TV icon in Roomote and choose your TV. If it does not appear, enter its local IP address.

  2. 02

    Say hello

    Enter the six-character pairing code shown on the TV. No developer settings or USB connection needed.

  3. 03

    Make it a movie night

    Use your phone to browse, select, and control playback. Your paired TV is saved for next time.

TV connected by Ethernet? It can work on the same reachable home network, too.

A little help connecting ↗

Before you settle in

A good match
for your living room?

Roomote works with compatible Android TV and Google TV devices that provide Android TV Remote Service v2. The TV brand alone does not determine compatibility.

Some keys and standby wake behavior depend on your TV, its settings, and the app currently open.

Check the details ↗
  • ✓
    An Android phone

    Android 8.0 or newer. Roomote is a phone app, with no companion app to install on a compatible TV.

  • ✓
    A compatible Android TV or Google TV

    Android TV Remote Service v5 or newer is the intended target. Older services and some Android boxes are not supported.

  • ✓
    A shared local network

    Your phone and TV must be able to reach each other. Guest-network isolation or a VPN can block the connection.

  • −
    Other TV systems are not supported

    Roomote does not control Roku, Fire TV, Samsung Tizen, or LG webOS, and does not provide infrared control or casting.
